Tag a faceted figure's shared y-axis title as an axis annotation

Source: R/cnSegmentPlot.R
INTERNAL_cn_seg_tag_axis_title.Rd

Internal helper for cnSegmentPlot(). ggplotly() renders a faceted plot's shared axis titles as paper-anchored annotations that are otherwise indistinguishable from facet strip labels, so VizModules::apply_axis_title_to_annotations() would style the y-axis title with the facet title font. Tagging it annotationType = "axis" routes it to the axis title font instead, and keys its dragged position by axis side.

Usage

.cn_seg_tag_axis_title(fig, y.title)

Arguments

fig

A plotly figure produced from a faceted ggplot.

y.title

The y-axis title text to look for.

Value

The figure, with the matching annotation tagged.

Jared Andrews
